report.explanation: Multiple, repeated high-confidence Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks detected across various types (HOIC, LOIC-UDP, LOIC-HTTP), indicating a sustained and severe threat to system availability.
recommended_actions: Isolate affected systems to prevent further impact
Block source IPs associated with the detected DDoS attacks at the network perimeter
Implement immediate DDoS mitigation strategies (e.g., rate limiting, traffic scrubbing)
Notify security operations center (SOC) for further investigation and response coordination
